scope: Public contract review for one atomic dimension-reconciliation boundary, provenance separation, case neutrality, and evidence limits.

checks.name: atomic_boundary
checks.notes: The operation reconciles supplied dimension statements and relations; it does not extract unrelated geometry or select a construction order.

checks.name: provenance_boundary
checks.notes: Every retained, derived, conflicting, or missing value is labeled observation, user, inference, or unresolved with source and unit context.

checks.name: case_neutrality
checks.notes: The contract contains no case identifiers, product labels, recorded aliases, or numeric examples and preserves unresolved scope decisions.

checks.name: evidence_boundary
checks.notes: Only design intent is reviewed; no implementation, application runtime, geometry measurement, persistence, visual acceptance, or export is claimed.

notes: Public design-only review record for the schema-bound 0.2.0 contract; it is not a host-check, source-interpretation accuracy result, or application evidence record.
